description: This source file defines an asynchronous workflow for a voice assistant bot, integrating various speech processing services, LLM services, and pipeline components using the Pipecat framework. It sets up services, functions, event handlers, and controls the conversation flow with service switching capabilities.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Defines the schema for a function that can be registered with an LLM or service switcher, including name, description, properties, and required fields.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Encapsulates a set of standard tools/functions available to the LLM, such as weather and restaurant recommendation functions.

classes.name: LocalSmartTurnAnalyzerV3
classes.description: Analyzes user turn strategies locally, used in user turn stopping conditions.

classes.name: SileroVADAnalyzer
classes.description: Voice activity detection analyzer based on the Silero model, configured with VADParams.

classes.name: DailyParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for Daily transport, including audio, VAD analyzer, etc.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Configuration for WebSocket transport via FastAPI, including audio, VAD analyzer, etc.

classes.name: BaseTransport
classes.description: Abstract base class for different transport mechanisms handling input/output.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents a sequence of steps (frames) for processing the conversational flow.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Defines a pipeline execution task with associated parameters and lifecycle controls.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Parameters to configure the behavior of the pipeline, such as metrics and timeouts.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution (start, cancel, handle signals) of a pipeline task.

classes.name: ServiceSwitcher
classes.description: Handles switchable services (e.g., STT, TTS) with strategies like manual selection.

classes.name: LLMSwitcher
classes.description: Manages multiple LLM backends, registration of functions, and direct functions.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Contains the context messages and tools for the LLM, used in conversation management.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Aggregates the context with user and assistant components, including strategies.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Implements user turn stopping strategy based on turn analysis.

methods.name: fetch_weather_from_api(params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch weather data and invoke a callback with results.

methods.name: get_restaurant_recommendation(params: FunctionCallParams, location: str)
methods.description: Asynchronous function to recommend a restaurant based on location, invoking a callback.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Sets up services, constructs the conversation pipeline, and runs the bot with event handlers.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry point for running the bot, establishing transport and initiating the workflow.
